effect.isekai_mahou.gambler_jackpot.desc: Infinite luck: every roll hits the maximum, full resource, strong regeneration and extra speed.
effect.isekai_mahou.gambler_jinxed.descr: Takes more damage, misses attacks and rolls worse luck.
effect.isekai_mahou.gambler_lucky.descri: Better luck rolls, better loot and a chance to dodge hits.
glyph.isekai_mahou.bungee_gum.desc: Effect (Gambler origin; a tribute to the card magician). Sticks a pink aura thread, elastic as rubber and sticky as gum. On an enemy: 3 damage and, for 6 s (Extend), it can't get farther than 4 blocks. SNEAK to contract: it flies to you and gets thrown where you look (8 damage on impact). Bosses are only tugged lightly. On yourself (Self): sticks to the block you look at (24 blocks) and pulls you there.
glyph.isekai_mahou.card_throw.desc: FORM (Gambler). Throws energy-charged cards that carry the spell and burst on hit. Each Split widens the fan by +2 cards (1, 3, 5...) and every card applies the effects (cost per copy). Pierce, Ricochet, Homing and Accelerate work; can be stage 2+.
glyph.isekai_mahou.casino_domain.desc: G FORM (Gambler ultimate). Opens a radius-10 casino around you for 12 s (Expand and Extend work). Every second luck is rolled and ALL enemies inside receive the effects at the rolled power (Sure Hit). Allies become Lucky, Tension rises and a Jackpot inside lasts ×1.5. Accepts Laws.
glyph.isekai_mahou.dice_roll.desc: FORM (Gambler). Throws two magic dice that bounce on the ground; when they stop, the SUM decides the blast (power = sum/7, radius 2.5 + sum/4). Doubles ×1.5; Boxcars (6+6) ×2.5 and +Tension; Snake Eyes (1+1) ×0.3. Split throws one extra die (added to the sum).
glyph.isekai_mahou.double_down.desc: AUGMENT (Gambler). Exaggerates the spell's luck: the good side doubles the gain (+50% becomes +100%), the bad side is halved. Doubles the JACKPOT chance and each roll's Tension. All or nothing!
glyph.isekai_mahou.fate_coin.desc: EFFECT (Gambler). A coin spins over the target: HEADS = 9 Light damage; TAILS = 4 Shadow damage and the target becomes Jinxed for 6 s. Your Luck raises the chance of Heads (up to 80%). Invert = always Tails.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gambler_all_in.desc: Effect (Gambler origin; a tribute to the compulsive-gambling anime). A dice duel against the target: both roll 2d6. If you win, you deal 10 + 2 × the difference, heal half, STEAL 1 good effect (+1 per Amplify) and 15%% of a player's mana; it becomes Jinxed and you Lucky. Tie: both take a little. If you lose, YOU take the damage (6 + 1.5 × difference) and it heals. Every bet has a risk.
glyph.isekai_mahou.gambler_fate_dice.des: Effect (Gambler origin). Two giant dice fall on the target and show its fate: 1.2 damage per pip of the sum. 2 (Snake Eyes): the bad luck turns on you (Jinxed). 7 (Lucky Seven): you heal and become Lucky. Doubles: ×1.5 and the target is Jinxed. 12: ×3 and a bolt of light (+10 Tension). Luck rerolls a low die; Loaded Dice: faces ≥ 3.
glyph.isekai_mahou.idle_death_gamble.des: Gambler G form (ultimate), House rank V (a tribute to the pachinko domain). A neon hall of radius 11 for 15 s (Expand/Extend). Every 2 s a ROUND: luck rolls and the effects hit every enemy inside (Sure Hit); then comes the Reach — Green, Red, Gold or Rainbow — with a 6%%/22%%/50%%/100%% JACKPOT chance (+3%% per round; Lesson: half). IMMORTAL JACKPOT: 251 ticks (the 4:11 became ticks) + 2 s per rank of infinite resource, full regeneration, its own music — and fatal blows don't kill. Accepts Domain Laws.
glyph.isekai_mahou.loaded_dice.desc: AUGMENT (Gambler). Steady result: removes Bust, Bad and Big Luck from the draw (half the Jackpot chance). On Dice, every face rolls 3 or higher.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lucky_charm.desc: EFFECT (Gambler, Light). The target becomes Lucky for 15 s (Amplify raises the level, up to III) and heals a little. Lucky: better rolls and loot and a chance to dodge hits. Invert = Jinxed on the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.roulette_wheel.desc: FORM (Gambler). A roulette appears where you aim (up to 24 blocks) and spins for 2.5 s with a ground warning. Red ×1.25; Black ×0.85 twice; green Zero ×3 and +Tension. Radius 4.5 (Expand works).
glyph.isekai_mahou.royal_flush.desc: EFFECT (Gambler). Draws a poker hand for each target: 8 damage × the hand (high card ×0.6 ... three of a kind ×1.5 · straight ×1.9 · flush ×2.2 · full house ×2.6 · four of a kind ×3.2 · straight flush ×4 · ROYAL FLUSH ×6). Luck draws extra cards (up to 8) and keeps the best hand.
glyph.isekai_mahou.slot_machine.desc: FORM (Gambler). Summons a machine in front of you; the 3 reels spin and the prize comes out as homing chips that carry the spell: nothing 1 chip ×0.7 · pair 3 ×1 · triple 5 ×1.5 · 7-7-7 7 chips ×2 and JACKPOT. Split = +1 chip.
glyph.isekai_mahou.texture_surprise.desc: Effect (Gambler origin; a tribute to the card magician). A sheet of illusion that changes what others see. On yourself (Self): DISGUISE for 6 s — invisible, monsters lose your trail and only notice you up close; the first hit or spell out of the disguise is a SURPRISE (+60%%). On an enemy: FAKE TEXTURE — up to 3 nearby monsters (+1 per Amplify) start attacking it, and it is blinded, nauseous and Jinxed (3 damage).
glyph.isekai_mahou.trigger_jackpot.desc: TRIGGER (Gambler, at the start of the recipe). The slot fires BY ITSELF, aiming at the nearest enemy, the moment you hit a JACKPOT — already at maximum power. Pressing the key does not cast it.
legend.isekai_mahou.gambler_all_or_nothi: The dice duel amplified and with the bet doubled, followed by the Dice of Fate. Winning pays a lot; losing hurts.
legend.isekai_mahou.gambler_bungee_trick: Three homing cards that stick the Elastic Gum and cover the target with Fake Texture: pull, throw and let the other monsters finish the job.
legend.isekai_mahou.gambler_immortal_jac: The enlarged pachinko domain: every round throws the Dice of Fate and draws a Royal Hand with the bet doubled — until the Immortal Jackpot.

screen.isekai_mahou.gambler.hint: Every spell of yours rolls luck. Bad luck fills Tension; at 100, the next roll is a JACKPOT.
screen.isekai_mahou.gambler.hint_other: Spells with Gambler glyphs (learned through a Lesson) also roll luck.
screen.isekai_mahou.gambler.round_tip: Bet the chips and win the Round: defeat the enemies before time runs out. Winning pays the bet back double.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.casino_chip: The bet for the Gambler's House Round. Dropped by Jackpots.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gambler_deck.flavor: "The house always wins... unless I am the house."
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gambler_deck.throw: Right-click: razor card (%s damage; Ace = double)
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gambler_outfit.casi: White and gold suit: the house is yours.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gambler_outfit.deal: Green visor, vest and bow tie: the one who deals the cards.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gambler_outfit.fort: A greatcoat where the suits glow. Luck obeys.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.gambler_outfit.high: Red-lapel tuxedo for the high stakes.
